jobs.occupation: Finance Manager, Strategic Finance, Synergies Enabler - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong financial toolbox, a strategic mindset and a passion for turning complex business challenges into tangible value? Would you like to play a key role in realizing the value from Arla’s merger with German dairy company DMK?

“As Finance Manager, Synergies Enabler you will become part of the team supporting synergy delivery from the merger with DMK. You will work closely with finance leaders and business stakeholders, acting as a synergy partner and helping connect strategic ambition with financial execution. You will combine hands-on financial analysis with stakeholder management and project execution,” says Theis Engedal Pedersen, Strategic Finance Director.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**Reporting to the Director of Strategic Finance, you will join a highly engaged team of eight finance professionals working close to Arla’s performance management agenda and across our global organization. Your key responsibilities will include

• Partner with finance leads and business stakeholders in solving synergy-related challenges, using financial analysis and modelling to translate business initiatives into measurable financial impact

• Support the identification and quantification of merger synergies, working closely with finance and business stakeholders to establish robust financial baselines, assumptions and value potential

• Support the tracking of synergy realization and P&L impact, creating transparency on progress and helping connect operational delivery with financial outcomes

• Drive efficient and transparent synergy reporting and help turn complex financial information into clear insights and messages for senior management

• Support the broader synergy agenda through strong project management, bringing structure, follow-up and momentum to initiatives involving stakeholders across the organization

**What will make you successful?

**We are looking for someone who combines strong financial capabilities with curiosity, business understanding and an ability to see the bigger picture. You enjoy getting into the details when necessary, but equally important, you can step back, connect the dots and turn complex information into a clear narrative. The ideal candidate brings

• 6+ years of relevant experience from finance or strategy functions; for example finance business partnering, strategic finance, consulting or corporate strategy

• A relevant university degree within Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills, with an ability to translate analysis into insights, recommendations and actions

• A strategic mind and ability to build the bigger picture and develop a compelling narrative from complex information

• A solid project management tool box and is comfortable bringing structure and momentum to complex, cross-functional initiatives.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to condense details into precise, executive-level messages

• Strong relationship building and sparring partnering, and is comfortable collaborating across functions and organizational levels.

**What do we offer?

**This is an opportunity to work on a complex, high-profile merger agenda, where strong partnering skills make a tangible difference to value creation. You will get exposure to a wide range of senior stakeholders across Finance and the wider Arla business and build a broad network across the organization. You will join a young, highly engaged and collaborative Strategic Finance team with strong opportunities for personal and professional development.

**Would you like to join us?

**If you want to help realise the value of the Arla-DMK merger and shape the future of dairy, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis and will close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information, please contact Theis Engedal Pedersen Director of Strategic Finance, on +45 9131 4630

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome.

As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce.

This is where you make a difference

You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation.

One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business.

From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership.

You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg.

Key responsibilities include:

• Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles

• Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles

• Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models

• Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions

What you bring

You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills:

• Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains

• Experience with cloud data platforms and integration architecture

• SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly around Business Partner data

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences

• Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Data engineering, integration or enterprise architecture

• Master data management, metadata, lineage and data quality disciplines

• Event-driven, API-based and batch integration patterns

• CargoWise, logistics or transport-related operations

• Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or similar technologies

• Advanced analytics, AI or relevant certifications such as TOGAF or DAMA

Why Blue Water

You will become part of a well-established Data Management team with strong professional capabilities across governance, master data, migration and quality.

What characterises the team is not only its expertise, but also its willingness to help each other succeed. We work closely together, challenge each other’s thinking and believe that the best solutions are created through collaboration across business and IT.

As part of the wider Operational Excellence organisation, you will work alongside colleagues specialising in process improvement, training and change management. Together, we are helping Blue Water build the capabilities needed for the future.

Interested?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data at Blue Water. If you are ready to make a real impact in a global organisation undergoing significant transformation, we would love to hear from you.

For questions about the role, please contact Kamil J. Karolak, Head of Data Management.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What we do – Together we create solutions

Blue Water Shipping is a global provider of all logistics services in modern supply chain management. Founded in Denmark in 1972, Blue Water is a global organisation of professionals, skilled in offering complete and tailor-made solutions to any shipping requirement anywhere in the world. We offer clients the best service and highest quality in the industry.

The company is represented by more than 80 offices in 30 countries worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise. Every day, our 2,800 employees present a broad range of services, from standardised solutions delivered with optimal user and customer focus, to tailor-made projects with co-created solutions for unique customer needs.

jobs.occupation: Product Coordinator - Data, structure, and coordination at the heart of our largest product category.
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who enjoys bringing order to complexity? Do you take pride in keeping track of details, data, and deadlines? Then you could be the Coordinator we are looking for in our Incontinence and baby diapers team at ABENA!

Incontinence and baby diapers are ABENA's largest product category. At the same time, we are welcoming new digital and innovative product areas into the team, creating exciting opportunities but also increasing the need for structure and coordination. That's why we are looking for a new colleague who can help keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.

This is a role with a very broad range of responsibilities. One day you might be updating master data, checking marketing materials, working with price lists, or creating Excel reports. The next day you could be following up on backorders, supporting a product launch, or helping solve an unexpected operational challenge. New tasks will constantly land on your desk, so it's important that you enjoy variety and take pride in bringing order to complexity.

Simply put, you are the person who puts things on track and helps keep the train moving.

You can expect your main tasks to include:

• Maintain product information and master data across our systems.

• Support new product launches and help coordinate activities across departments.

• Follow up on backorders and product availability, keeping Sales updated.

• Create reports and work with product, pricing, and sales data in Excel.

• Support process improvements, data clean-up, and documentation of workflows.

• Prepare project updates, newsletters, and other communication for internal stakeholders.

We hope you bring:

• A relevant education within business, administration, supply chain, marketing, or a related field.

• An interest in working with product data, reports, and master data, along with a willingness to learn new systems.

• Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

• The ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and keep track of many moving parts.

• Confidence working in Excel and a curiosity for turning data into useful insights.

• A proactive and helpful mindset, with a genuine desire to support colleagues and contribute wherever needed.

Your Team, Our Culture and Values

Our team brings together five complementary experts in product management, sourcing, and compliance. We’re driven by a genuine passion for our work and a deep commitment to our category and products. We support one another, celebrate our successes together, and ensure we thrive as a team.

Your leader at ABENA will be Group Concept Manager Birgitte Hausted, who describes her leadership style as follows:

“I adapt my leadership style to the people and teams I work with, and I always meet others with respect for their expertise and strengths. I don’t see failure as losing. I see it as learning and getting better together. Trust and transparency matter a lot to me, and I believe we do our best work when we reflect on and grow as a team.”

Your workplace will be located at the ABENA Headquarter in Aabenraa, Denmark.

At ABENA, you join a global company with a strong purpose: To make a real difference in the everyday lives of people around the world. We combine professionalism with a warm, people-first culture where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement are necessary parts of everyday life. We take pride in delivering high-quality work with integrity, guided by our core values of trust, fairness, and cooperation. These values shape how we lead, support one another, and create meaningful impact for our customers and communities.

We look forward to receiving your application

If you are interested in the position, please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We process applications as we receive them, and we close the search when we have found our new colleague.

Read more about our recruitment process here.

If you would like further information about the job, please feel free to contact Birgitte Hausted, Group Concept Manager, on +45 5158 0484.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Danfoss Business System (DBS) was founded in 2003 and is a world class improvement organization with one overall purpose: To ensure that Danfoss has a best-in-class performance. The organization consists of highly qualified specialists split into more than 20 nationalities, who can all challenge and support the businesses as well as develop the practices and solutions needed to take Danfoss to the next level.

DBS specializes in supporting Danfoss factories with a standardized approach to continuously strengthen Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Inventory.

As a Delivery Performance Excellence Expert, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement effective supply chain processes that improve delivery performance to customers and enhance customer satisfaction, with a strong end-to-end focus. The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to transformation initiatives and make a tangible impact on business results.

In this role, you will be operating in a multicultural environment with highly competent colleagues from all over the world.

We are a global organization with more than 100 factories across the world and therefore it is important that you have the flexibility and willingness to travel, approx. 70% of the time supporting our various locations. When not travelling, you will have the flexibility of working from home or from one of our offices.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead supply chain transformation projects across manufacturing sites, identifying and implementing end-to-end improvements in planning, procurement, production, logistics, and customer service.

• Drive delivery performance excellence using DBS methodologies, helping factories improve customer delivery results and achieve ambitious performance targets.

• Implement and strengthen performance management systems, using data and insights to monitor results, identify gaps, and accelerate improvements.

• Drive continuous improvement across Delivery and Inventory through facilitation of Kaizen workshops, process mapping activities, and capability-building initiatives, enabling teams to adopt sustainable ways of working.

• Partner with stakeholders across operations, supply chain, and support functions to build a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and high performance.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Proven experience in supply chain management within a manufacturing environment, with expertise in areas such as SIOP, Planning, Procurement, CRM, WMS, or TMS

• Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes and hands-on experience leading supply chain transformation and performance improvement initiatives in manufacturing Industry or consultancy supporting manufacturing industry.

• Experience working with SAP, Planning & Forecasting systems, SAP BI, Power BI, and advanced Excel for analysis and decision-making.

• Strong project leadership, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence teams across a matrix organization. A structured, analytical, and data-driven approach to problem-solving, combined with excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Interest and experience in digital technologies, data analytics, process transformation, and operational excellence.

• Willingness and flexibility to travel globally up to 70% of the time.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. More information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

You will set the commercial direction, strengthen key customer relationships and further develop our sales capabilities, while ensuring strong execution across pricing, pipeline management and business development.

Reporting to the VP Service, you will be a key member of the Service leadership team and play an important role in shaping the future direction and continued growth of the business.

Anne Høj

anhoj@kkgroup.com

Building on more than 40 years of experience, KK Group is a leading systems supplier to the renewable energy industry. Our capabilities span the development of state-of-the-art technologies, high-quality lean manufacturing, and flexible aftermarket services.

From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• 
Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• 
Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

•

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

Are you passionate about product data and the systems that turn it into consistent, high-quality experiences everywhere it's used? Do you enjoy the technical challenge of connecting complex data flows across platforms? Do you thrive on making product information easy to find, understand, and trust—for customers and for AI? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Pandora's team is looking for a Product Manager to own our Product Information Management (PIM) practice. PIM is central to our architecture, syndicating product data to ecommerce, marketplaces, retail, and marketing systems, so you'll work at the intersection of data architecture, content quality, and discoverability.

As our new Product Manager, you'll own the product strategy and delivery for our PIM platform, with InRiver preferred as our PIM technology. You'll work closely with data, engineering, and content teams to define the data model, govern data quality, and ensure product information flows correctly to every downstream channel.

This role is critical to how our products are found and understood—not just by customers on our own site, but increasingly by AI-driven answer engines and generative search. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands-on technical execution, vendor management, and continuous improvement of our data model.

Help Write Our Next Chapter - Job Responsibilities:

• Own the product roadmap and backlog for our PIM platform, ensuring the data model and architecture support both business and technical needs

• Design and optimize data flows between PIM and downstream systems (ecommerce, marketplaces, DAM, ERP), working closely with engineering

• Partner with content, SEO, and marketing teams to structure and enrich product information for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

• Manage vendor relationships, including roadmap alignment, issue escalation, and feature adoption

• Monitor data quality, syndication performance, and platform health, identifying optimization opportunities and driving continuous improvement

• Stay ahead of trends in PIM, product data architecture, and AI-driven discovery, bringing forward strategic recommendations

We would love if you could bring:

• 5+ years of experience in product management, data platforms, or PIM—ideally within ecommerce or product content operations

• Technical understanding of PIM architecture, data modeling, and system integrations (APIs, ETL, syndication)

• Experience with InRiver or similar PIM platforms preferred

• Experience optimizing product information for AEO and GEO—structured data, schema markup, and content formats that AI systems and search engines can parse

• Experience writing clear product requirements and managing backlogs in tools like JIRA

• Analytical mindset with a focus on measuring data quality and discoverability impact

• Excellent stakeholder management skills—you can navigate between technical and business teams with ease

• Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, consent management) is a plus

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we’d love to hear your story!

Meet the People Behind the Sparkle

You’ll join our Product Management team, alongside colleagues in Copenhagen and Baltimore, working in a collaborative and international environment. Reporting directly to the Director, Product Management, you’ll work closely with teams across e-commerce, stores, retail technology, brand, marketplaces and local markets, giving you broad exposure across Pandora and plenty of opportunity to collaborate across the business.

Further Information:

Global Career Band: This role is a Manager, Band 4B, individual contributor position.

Be Part of Something Beautiful

At Pandora, we’re crafting more than jewellery. We’re creating the future of an iconic global brand. You’ll work from our Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen alongside talented colleagues from around the world, helping shape the digital experiences, platforms, and technologies that support millions of customers and employees every day. From our LEED Gold-certified workplace to our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and craftsmanship, Pandora offers an environment where you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and make a lasting impact.

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology site in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s ambitions. Besides our inspiring workplace design, we’re proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This reflects our commitment to using natural resources responsibly and creating a space that is professional, dynamic, comfortable, and uniquely Pandora. The result is a workplace that is innovative, collaborative and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here or comes to visit.

Join us in this role where you will contribute to the development and implementation of our global workplace strategy and translate business requirements into effective, future-focused workplace solutions. Working closely with internal specialists and external partners, you will bring together the expertise needed to shape solutions aligned with our global Love Your Workplace concept. You will lead workplace projects from early location analysis and space planning through workplace programming, where data, business requirements, work patterns and stakeholder needs are translated into clear workplace requirements and design briefs. This is a role for someone who enjoys being close to the numbers while taking ownership of the accounting questions behind them. You’ll have room to apply your expertise across reporting processes, accounting governance and IFRS as the business develops.

Your work combines recurring financial controlling and Group reporting with accounting assessments that require deeper analysis.

This position is based at our Aarhus office, with flexibility to work from home when it fits the work and the team. Expect around 5–10 days of travel each year.

LET'S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You enjoy working close to the numbers and digging deeper when an accounting question requires it. You approach complex questions with curiosity and structure, connecting the details to the broader reporting picture and turning your conclusions into something others can use.

• Solid knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting, with an interest in developing further expertise within technical accounting.
